surface_forms: la jeune cycliste de la petite bande

appraisal_events.evidence: je la vis sous les arbres adresser à Elstir un salut souriant d'amie, arc-en-ciel qui unit pour moi notre monde terraqué à des régions que j'avais jugées jusque-là inaccessibles
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator idealizes Albertine on first recognizing her, casting her as a radiant bridge to a desired, previously inaccessible world—an earnest expression of admiration distinct from the Elstir-focused prestige event already captured.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's idealizing reaction to her appearance and gesture elevates Albertine's emotional standing as an object of admiration and longing.

ambiguities: The candidate 'le peintre' refers to the same referent as the already-scored 'Elstir' in this passage (Albertine 'tendre la main au peintre' immediately follows the Elstir mention), so it was treated as coreferential and not separately scored.

The narrator's hope of being introduced to Albertine and the anticipatory 'magnifique goûter' metaphor register mainly as his own internal hope/perception rather than a staged social outcome landing on him within this passage, so 'le narrateur' was not scored.

Legrandin is only recalled indirectly (his earlier advice about Brittany), and Elstir's counter-philosophy about dreams could be read as implicitly undercutting that advice, but the passage stops short of any explicit blame or mockery of Legrandin, so this was judged too diffuse to score.
